entities.summary: John Edward McCarthy was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church.He served as bishop of the Diocese of Austin in Texas from 1985 to 2001. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Galveston-Houston in Texas from 1979 to 1985.
